thread:
Maya Lee: Heads up — Solitude Labs showing a sharp usage drop over the last 2 weeks, procurement changed hands, and we have a competitor trial in flight. Need a quick renewal triage and a short plan. TL;DR: usage -72% WoW, champion is out. Anyone available for a 30m sync?
onboard-bot: Automated usage report for account=solitude-labs:
  - 24h tokens: 3.2k
  - 7d tokens: 18k (\u221272% WoW)
  - Top routes: embed-search (down 84%), assistant-chat (down 64%)
  - Last activity: 2026-03-10 by sol-dev@solitude.com
  - Notes: procurement tag added: apexserve-trial
  - Logs: https://redwood.app/logs/solitude-labs
Olivia Park: I see error/429 spikes on /api/generate around the same window — looks like client-side throttling + retries. Could be masking as a usage drop. I'll pull request-level logs and surface the top failing routes.
Jordan Kim: Procurement notes show they started a trial with ApexServe on Mar 8 and requested a dedicated throughput test. We should prepare two offers: a short Dedicated trial (2w) and a performance/cost demo of our batching + caching.
Ethan Ross: I can join procurement. Two options to pitch: (A) 2-week Dedicated trial at 50% discount, (B) profile + SRE session to cut unit cost and improve p95 latency. Thoughts?
Maya Lee: Prefer (B) first — faster and cheaper to deliver. Procurement will still want numbers though. Olivia, can you get a before/after sim for batching + prefix cache?
Olivia Park: Prelim sim: batching + prefix caching -> ~30% token reduction for their median seq length. Quantization/opt could add ~10-15% infra savings but requires model validation. I'll run a more robust sim and upload by EOD.
Ravi Patel: I can draft a tailored renewal playbook + procurement email template with 2 options and clear metrics (QPS, p95, cost delta scenarios).
Maya Lee: Also we should ask for an exec QBR slot — 45min tech + procurement call. Ethan, can you lock calendars? Jordan, prepare an auto-fallback plan if they test Dedicated (so they don't go dark on errors).
Ethan Ross: Provisional slot booked: Wed 10am PT. I've pinged procurement contact (procurement@solitude.com) and the current champion's replacement.
Jordan Kim: Putting together a canary routing snippet to propose on the call — quick preview:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: dedicated-2x
  fallback: hosted-lowcost
  monitor: [latency,pct_errors]
  rollback: automatic
```
Send me any hard constraints we need to encode.
Maya Lee: Perfect. Olivia — please share sim results + one-slide perf/cost delta. Ravi — draft the outreach template. I'll open the call framing it as "risk mitigation + upsides" rather than a concession. :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: Uploading sim results now: https://redwood.app/sims/solitude-batching. Note: they have long-tail seqs (p99 ~820 tokens) so prefix caching gives less lift on p99; recommend a short session to discuss trimming and prompt engineering.
Maya Lee: Great. Next steps recap: 1) Olivia EOD sim + slide, 2) Ravi draft procurement email, 3) Ethan confirm call attendees, 4) Jordan finalize canary YAML. I'll run the call and lead negotiation. Will update thread after the call. :eyes:
